node_definition.done_when:
Give each duplicated picker helper one owner. These are the two duplicate-owner findings of the 2026-10-07 design review of one-typesafe-model-picker. The review record is docs/state/reckon/reviews/plan/one-typesafe-model-picker/r-20261007T022426882870-plan-review-of-one-typesafe-model-picker.json; read both findings in full.

1. The run-time-profile cache in reckon/crew/picker/lane_context.py hand-rolls a schema-marked, atomic, stamp-keyed persisted cache: _read_persisted_profile, _write_persisted_profile, _profile_key, _stat_stamp, _ledger_stamp and _cached_run_time_profile. capabilities.cached_pick_input and capabilities.file_stamp in reckon/capabilities.py already provide that cache. Make the profile cache go through cached_pick_input, under its own cache kind if one is needed, and delete the hand-rolled reader, writer and stamps.
2. lane_context._bucket duplicates run_time_profile._size_class, with the same 30/60-minute budget thresholds and the same 20k/100k output-token thresholds. _number is copied at lane_context.py, run_time_profile.py and picker/outcomes.py, and _percentile at run_time_profile.py and picker/outcomes.py. Keep one owner of each in reckon/crew/run_time_profile.py, and import it everywhere else.
3. lane_context.py re-reads the lane document that run_time_profile.local_lane_load() has just read. Use the value local_lane_load already returned.
4. Every rendered picker state, every bucket and every profile figure is unchanged. Prove it with a test in tests/test_picker_helpers_have_one_owner.py that renders state.jinja for a fixture before and after: compute both in the test from the same fixture, and assert the result is byte-identical. Also add a test that fails if a second _bucket, _number or _percentile definition appears under reckon/crew/picker/.

Do not edit reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py or reckon/crew/routing.py; run pick-candidates-one-pass owns them now. Do not edit reckon/crew/dispatch.py or reckon/cli.py either; they are on hold for a module split. Gate: tests/test_picker_helpers_have_one_owner.py, every tests/test_picker*.py, tests/test_run_time_profile*.py, tests/test_jev_weighs_context.py, and every tests/ file that imports reckon.capabilities, lane_context or run_time_profile. Build that list from your head tree with grep -l. Run with the main checkout's .venv/bin/python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -n 8 in the FOREGROUND, with one log each for base and head under the run directory, each ending in an EXIT line, judged by delta. Write the evidence fragment docs/evidence/fragments/one-typesafe-model-picker/picker-helpers-have-one-owner.html.
